title: GEOS Atmosphere Composition Analysis
description: GEOS-CF (Goddard Earth Observing System Composition Forecast) high-temporal-resolution atmospheric composition analysis from NASA GMAO. Provides global 15-minute interval gridded data at 0.25-degree resolution covering aerosols and atmospheric trace gases. The analysis product spans 2018 to present with approximately a one-day latency, stored in Icechunk/Zarr format.
